item.title: Kishiwada Danjiri Matsuri: The Runaway-Float Festival — Guide
item.description: The Kishiwada Danjiri Matsuri, held each September in the coastal city of Kishiwada, is the most exhilarating and famously reckless festival in Osaka. Teams of hundreds haul danjiri — massive, intricately carved wooden floats weighing several tonnes — through the town not in stately procession but at a flat-out run, the great skill and danger coming at the corners, where the pullers whip the float around a sharp turn without slowing while a leader dances on the roof.
